reasoning: A clear lightbulb struck through with a diagonal slash immediately reads as lights off, a burnt-out bulb, or a lighting outage. It fits household maintenance tasks (replacing dead bulbs, fixing fixtures), smart-home automation for turning lights off, and leaving-home checklists, though the unslashed lightbulb covers a broader range of general lighting and idea tasks.
